richiami.difetto: A certain production batch of Snell Powerlink X-ring chain with product ID Art. 1727-530DX-124 Art. 1727-525DX-118 and Art. 1727-520DX-114 may have been affected by manufacturing defects.
richiami.modello: Snell Powerlink X-ring chain 1727-530DX-124 , Snell Powerlink X-ring chain 1727-530DX-124
richiami.rimedio: Users are strongly advised to stop using this product immediately particularly if any cracks or deformation in the links appear. Do not use a vehicle on which the mentioned chain has been installed until such time as the chain has been replaced.
